articles.title: India’s financial intelligence unit flags 15 crypto platforms for AML lapses
articles.snippet: The Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND) issued non-compliance notices to what it calls virtual digital asset service providers.

articles.title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion
articles.snippet: The blockchain intelligence firm said its annual recurring revenue has quadrupled over the past three years as it expands its AI-powered investigations business.

articles.title: U.S. Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
articles.snippet: The pilot moved USBDC between the bank’s North American and European entities on the public Stellar blockchain.

articles.title: What could happen if the CLARITY Act fails to pass in 2026
articles.snippet: The US Senate has a limited window to pass a crypto market structure bill, but if it were to fail, the legislation could be completely remade or scrapped under Democrats in 2027.

articles.title: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams
articles.snippet: Blockchain sleuths at Elliptic traced the money, Treasury sanctioned the marketplace, and Xinbi—which ran $24 billion through a Telegram scam bazaar—called the freeze unfair.
